description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Mordekaiser''' aims his mace towards the target enemy champion, [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 75% and [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealing]] them over the cast time, and then [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death banished icon.png|20px|link=]] banishing them with him to the ''Death Realm'' for 7 seconds.

'''Mordekaiser''' also consumes the target's soul for 7 seconds, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself for 10% of their '''maximum''' health and reducing their '''current''' [[File:Ability power icon.svg|15px|link=Ability power]] ability power, [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''total''' attack speed, [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health, [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] armor, [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] magic resistance, and [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|size]] by 10% for the duration. Additionally, the target's [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''base''' attack damage is reduced by 10% of their '''current total''' AD for the same duration. '''Mordekaiser''' gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration, and if the target dies while inside the ''Death Realm'', he keeps their partial stats until they [[death|respawn]].
description.text:
Active: Mordekaiser aims his mace towards the target enemy champion, slowing them by 75% and revealing them over the cast time, and then banishing them with him to the Death Realm for 7 seconds.
Mordekaiser also consumes the target's soul for 7 seconds, healing himself for 10% of their maximum health and reducing their current  ability power,  total attack speed,  maximum health,  armor,  magic resistance, and size by 10% for the duration. Additionally, the target's  base attack damage is reduced by 10% of their current total AD for the same duration. Mordekaiser gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration, and if the target dies while inside the Death Realm, he keeps their partial stats until they respawn.

description3.raw: Units between realms see each other as spirits. Only '''Mordekaiser''' and the target will enter the realm; other champions cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the ''Death Realm'' is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa. Most [[File:Summon Tibbers.png|20px|link=Pets|An icon representing the keyword Pet]] [[:Pets|pets]] still inside the realm are killed at its end.

The Death Realm is a battlefield that exists outside of the normal realm in an alternate "dimension". It exists only for Mordekaiser and his target. It consists of an arena that has a radius of 1200 units and includes any terrain features that would exist in the map of the normal realm, including walls and brushes.
* Structures exist in all realms at the same time. Turrets will behave normally as if all units were in the same realm.
* The boundaries of the arena are impassable but not considered terrain themselves ( Unstoppable Onslaught exception), and enemies that try to move out of the area will be displaced back inside.
* Dashes, blinks, displacements and other forms of movement will cap their effect range to the boundary. Targets will stop at the boundary even after it expired.
* During the cast time of Realm of Death, it is possible to pathfind outside the boundaries of the arena by issuing a movement command toward an area that becomes inaccessible due to terrain inside the Death Realm.(bug)[https://youtu.be/LXQSroimFSw]Category:Unexpected behaviours
Realm of Death retains Mordekaiser's previous current health percentage when granting him a portion of the target's maximum health.
Realm of Death's healing is affected by healing modifiers.
Realm of Death's target will be marked by Mordekaiser for assist credit when entering the Death Realm.
Realm of Death does not trigger in-combat effects.
Realm of Death will cancel and go on cooldown after its cast time if:
* The target is displacement immune, crowd control immune or protected by a spell shield.
** Note that all of the above are ineffective if they are applied after the target has been banished.
* The target is a clone or Sion when his Glory in Death is active.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, is too far away or Mordekaiser loses sight of them due to nearsight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown.
If either Mordekaiser or the target dies at the same time of the transition into the Death Realm, the Death Realm will not end prematurely and will continue until its full duration has ended.(bug)[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7jPwQQhHfI]
* If the target dies this way, Mordekaiser will not keep their stats after leaving the Death Realm.
* Tahm Kench's Devour will always trigger this bug if used during the cast of Realm of Death and the spit would kill Mordekaiser.[https://youtu.be/Og98A3kQ-os]Category:Unexpected behaviours
If Mordekaiser or the target cast another Realm of Death, the affected champions will remain stuck for the duration of the new circle.
* The previous circle will be overridden by the new one; it will be dispelled to enter the new circle.
Spell shield will not block the initial slow.
The reveal effect lasts for 1.25 seconds from the start of the cast time if the cast does not complete. Otherwise, the reveal ends as soon as the cast time completes.
Upon entering or leaving the Death Realm, targets revealed by effects such as Ignite or Ashe's Hawkshot will keep the reveal VFX but will stop being revealed.(bug)[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lhY6ZTkISYM]Category:Unexpected behaviours
Camouflaged units will become visible if an enemy champion is within their detection range, even if the champion is in a different realm.(bug)
If the target's current health is lower than the amount that should be stolen, they will be brought down to 1 health. Mordekaiser will still get the intended amount of maximum health.
Realm of Death's maximum health reduction ignores invulnerability effects.
Entering or leaving the Death Realm will cause all targeted projectiles to be destroyed.
The transition in and out of the Death Realm doesn't interrupt channels.
* Grand Starfall will always be interrupted by the transition into the realm.
Realm of Death will not be dispelled if either of the two affected champions enter resurrection after taking lethal damage. It is dispelled if the target enters a zombie state.
Any active tether effects (both friendly and hostile ones) existing on either of the two champions entering the realm will be broken (unless the tether is between those two).
Upon entering the realm, Mordekaiser and the target are cleansed from all forced action effects.
* The cleanse will occur even if the source of the crowd control enters the realm.(unexpected)
Unlike the other stats, Mordekaiser does not steal enemy total size; instead he gains 10% of his own size and reduces the enemy's size by 10% of theirs (all size modifiers stack additively).
* Mordekaiser grows in size over 0.25 seconds after successfully stealing his targets' stats, and shrinks over 0.25 seconds after the buff runs out again. The target shrinks over 0.25 seconds after their stats are stolen, but grows back to normal size instantly when the effect ends.
While Mordekaiser has hold of his enemy's stats, that champion's circular portrait will appear as a pip next to his health bar, visible to all players.
* The champion's portrait will ocasionally stay even after Mordekaiser has lost hold of the enemy's stats.(bug)

Champions are only affected by their boundaries and are not able to see the others.
